name: omi_record_seal_repair_rows
description: Singleton row outcomes; disposition is a closed runtime allowlist, never provider text.
filter: resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.namespace_name="prod-omi-backend" AND resource.labels.container_name="repair" AND jsonPayload.logger="record-seal-repair" AND jsonPayload.message:"\"event\": \"record_seal_repair_row\""

name: omi_record_seal_repair_seal_age_seconds
description: Observed age in seconds, not a complete backlog census.
filter: resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.namespace_name="prod-omi-backend" AND resource.labels.container_name="repair" AND jsonPayload.logger="record-seal-repair" AND jsonPayload.message:"\"event\": \"record_seal_repair_row\"" AND jsonPayload.message=~"\"disposition\": \"sealed(_registered)?\""

name: omi_record_seal_repair_oldest_unsealed_seconds
description: Observed age in seconds, not a complete backlog census.
filter: resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.namespace_name="prod-omi-backend" AND resource.labels.container_name="repair" AND jsonPayload.logger="record-seal-repair" AND jsonPayload.message:"\"event\": \"record_seal_repair\"" AND jsonPayload.message:"\"outcome\": \"ok\""

name: omi_record_seal_repair_proof_refused
description: Proof refusals by closed sub-reason; counts only, no terminal classification.
filter: resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.namespace_name="prod-omi-backend" AND resource.labels.container_name="repair" AND jsonPayload.logger="record-seal-repair" AND jsonPayload.message:"\"event\": \"record_seal_repair_row\"" AND jsonPayload.message=~"\"disposition\": \"proof_refused\""

name: omi_record_seal_repair_tail_gap
description: Tail-lagging refusals by closed finish-minus-audio-end gap bucket; counts only.
filter: resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.namespace_name="prod-omi-backend" AND resource.labels.container_name="repair" AND jsonPayload.logger="record-seal-repair" AND jsonPayload.message:"\"event\": \"record_seal_repair_row\"" AND jsonPayload.message=~"\"disposition\": \"proof_refused\"" AND jsonPayload.message=~"\"proof_reason\": \"tail_lagging\""
